## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-52d874ad)

## Summary

REV35-UX140 stage (b): mounts the last 3 legacy-only surfaces into the workflow shell — no feature drops, so stage (c) can delete the `OptimizationWorkspaceWindow` chain.

- **リスニング集団** (`SeatPriorityPanel`): mounted on `RoomWorkspace.placement_panel` between `video_panel` and `standards_panel`. `RoomWorkspace._sync_seat_priority_panel()` refreshes it from `controller.committed_document` on placement entry, `activate()`, and `_refresh()` — the same contract the legacy `TheaterEditorWindow` dock followed per rebuild.
- **音場エクスプローラー** (`FieldExplorerPanel`): `RoomPredictionPanel.field_explorer_button` (「音場エクスプローラー…」) opens a `QDialog` hosting the same widget. Same gating as the legacy dock — enabled only while the selected run carries a `geometry_modes` result with `exact_for_model_geometry`. `open_for_run` → `refresh_sessions()` → `show()`/`raise_()`.
- **伝達行列** (O531 transfer-matrix grid): `RoomPredictionPanel.refresh_matrix()` is a verbatim port of the legacy `refresh_matrix_dock` — status label (`spec_name` + `実行 {attempt}: {run_state}` + `鮮度 {currency_state}` / `行列なし · reason`), read-only `matrix_table` with the legacy tooltip, `行列を再読み込み` reload button, all driven by the same `PredictionMatrixService.matrix_presentation` authority.

`FieldExplorerPanel`'s combos also joined the workflow width contract (`minimumContentsLength` + `AdjustToMinimumContentsLengthWithIcon`) — `test_prediction_combos_do_not_impose_wide_minimum` sweeps `findChildren(QComboBox)` including the new dialog.

All 3 strict-`xfail` parity tests converted to passing tests; behavior coverage added where the legacy surfaces were unique (committed-seat resync, exact-modes gating + `open_for_run`, persisted-spec grid render). `docs/reviews/rev35-ux140.md` updated — zero legacy-only surfaces remain.

## Tests

`pytest backend/tests/test_rev35_ux140.py` — 11 passed (was 5 + 3 xfail).
